from math import sqrt

points = [
    (12, -7),
    (-33, 25),
    (41, 18),
    (-8, -44),
    (27, 39),
    (-46, -12),
    (5, 14),
    (36, -29),
    (-19, 47),
    (-2, 3),
]
closest = farthest = None
for i in range(len(points)):
    for j in range(i + 1, len(points)):
        dx, dy = points[i][0] - points[j][0], points[i][1] - points[j][1]
        squared = dx * dx + dy * dy
        pair = (squared, i, j)
        if closest is None or squared < closest[0]:
            closest = pair
        if farthest is None or squared > farthest[0]:
            farthest = pair
for label, (squared, i, j) in [("closest", closest), ("farthest", farthest)]:
    distance = sqrt(squared)
    print(f"{label}: P{i} P{j} {distance:.4f}")
